ainsight_langgraph.svg.description: Three agents search news, summarize it, and format the results for publication.

car_buyer_agent_langgraph.png.description: The buyer agent asks for requirements, builds filters, searches listings and can fetch more details.

chiron.svg.description: The learning agent generates checkpoints and verifies each learner answer before advancing.

contentIntelli.svg.description: Summary and research feed the intent-matching node, which routes to platform-specific generators.

contextual_quoting_graph.svg.description: The entry router chooses quoting or underwriting, with retrieval and tool calls inside each branch.

essay_grading_system_langgraph.svg.description: The grading graph checks relevance, grammar, structure and depth before assigning a grade.

graph_inspector_system_langgraph.svg.description: Static inspection comes before descriptions, generated test cases, execution and result analysis.

journalism_focused_ai_assistant_langgrap.description: The category node selects fact checking, grammar and bias review, quote extraction, summarization or tone analysis.

mcp_architecture.png.description: The MCP host connects to separate servers. Some read local sources; another calls a remote service.

customized_mcp_host.png.description: The host either returns a direct response or calls an MCP server and formats the tool result.

memory-enhanced-email-agent.svg.description: The email agent triages the message and draws on episodic, semantic and procedural memory before responding.

music_composer_agent_langgraph.svg.description: The composition graph combines melody, harmony, rhythm and style before MIDI conversion.

podcast_generating_system_langgraph.jpg.description: Research and a host–expert exchange feed a script; introduction, report and conclusion join at finalization.

project_manager_assistant_agent.svg.description: Project planning proceeds through tasks, dependencies, scheduling, allocation and risk analysis.

self_healing_code.png.description: After a local code run fails, the workflow searches memory, proposes a patch and reruns the code.

tts_poem_generator_agent_langgraph.svg.description: A classifier chooses a content branch; each branch passes its text to speech synthesis.
